notes.title: Bugfix Update
notes.content:
Hi all. We have a bugfix update today to fix up some game breaking errors.

[list]
[*] Fixed softlock preventing the final bosses in the first and second postgame maps from being defeated.
[*] Fixed Axel's infinite item duplication and crash (maybe) in Chapter 3.
[*] Miscellaneous minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Thanks for bearing with us.

Note: We're aware of some issues with the game on Steam deck, but we don't have a test device, so we apologize for not being able to resolve them.
